ResearchProjectDef.label: fueled generators
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build generators that produce power by burning fuel: chemfuel generators refueled by hand and, with helixien gas, gas generators connected to a gas pipe network.

ResearchProjectDef.label: wind power
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build wind-powered electrical generators, from older windmills to modern wind turbines. They need a large clear space in front and behind for optimal air flow.

ResearchProjectDef.label: muscle-powered generators
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build devices that generate power from manual motion, such as a human hamster wheel or a bicycle generator.
